overview.description: The DB Gold Double Long Exchange Traded Notes (DGP) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in gold commodities. The fund provides 2x the daily performance of futures contracts relating to gold. The notes index selects contracts based on the shape of the futures curve to minimize contango. DGP was launched on Feb 27, 2008 and is issued by DB.
